howto: Pick Easy, Normal or Hard and press Play.
Your builder runs on his own and picks up every plank bundle he touches; they stack up on his back.
At a gap he lays your planks as a bridge; with too few planks he falls in the lake.
Reach the finish flag to win. Tap, click or Space jumps.
tips: Stay low: jumping carries you over planks you wanted.
Every finished bridge gives 5 bonus planks, so the first gaps matter most.
The more planks you carry, the faster a bridge goes up.
Your speed creeps up after the first 200 m: collect early, while it is easy.

controls.keyboard: Space or Up to jump; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Tap the course to jump; the pause button sits top left

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title card: Easy starts slower, tops out lower, lays 64 planks and 5 gaps; Hard is faster with 38 planks and 8 gaps.

features.one-tap-start: One Play button on the title card (difficulty remembered)
features.instant-restart: Run again on the results card, the Restart button under the track, or Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: Best distance and wins on the title card; the plank count and a distance bar with every gap marked sit over the course
features.tutorial-card: An animated 'Tap to jump' card before the first run; Replay tutorial in How to play
features.results: Results card with distance, gaps bridged, planks left, difficulty and best distance

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low button on the title card (Low renders at 1x with no shadows, fences, flowers or lily pads; a CPU-rendered device starts on Low)
